This maize plot is small, only 0.10 hectares, but maize is important for my family's food. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, and here in Oromia the cooperative sometimes brings DAP and urea, though it comes late. I will try to get a little fertilizer and use some manure from my animals since the plot is close to home. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year and pesticide is expensive, so I will use seed I saved and rely on my own hands and my family for weeding.
